title: Finetuning VLAs for Dexterous Manipulation: The Right Checkpoint Is All You Need
abstract: arXiv:2611.23676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated strong manipulation capabilities. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. In this work, we study how to best adapt VLAs to dexterous hands by pairing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL). Using $\pi_{0.5}$ and a LEAP hand, we evaluate five fine-tuning recipes across two simulation tasks using only a handful of demonstrations. Our empirical analysis yields three key insights: (1) SFT success is poorly correlated with post-DSRL success, meaning the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most effective to steer; (2) freezing the vision-language model (VLM) and tuning only the action expert produces the most steerable policy for both training and out-of-d

translated_title: 面向灵巧操作的视觉-语言-动作模型微调：选对检查点才是关键
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已展现出强大的操作能力。VLA模型的一个局限在于，大多数操作数据集都聚焦于平行夹爪系统，这使得向多指灵巧手的迁移颇具挑战，尤其是使用多指机器人采集遥操作数据集更为困难。在本工作中，我们研究了如何最佳地将VLA模型适配到灵巧手上，方法是将监督微调（SFT）与扩散引导强化学习（DSRL）相结合。我们使用 π0.5 模型和 LEAP 手，在两个仿真任务上仅用少量演示数据评估了五种微调方案。我们的实证分析得出了三个关键洞见：（1）SFT 的成功率与 DSRL 之后的成功率相关性很弱，这意味着最优的 SFT 检查点往往不是最适合进行引导（steering）的检查点；（2）冻结视觉-语言模型（VLM）、仅微调动作专家模块，无论在训练分布内还是分布外都能产生最可引导的策略（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现，用SFT结合扩散引导强化学习（DSRL）将VLA适配到灵巧手时，SFT最优检查点与DSRL后最优策略并不一致，且冻结VLM、仅微调动作专家模块能得到最可引导的策略，因此选择正确的检查点至关重要。
en_tdlr: When adapting VLAs to dexterous hands via SFT paired with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning, the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most steerable one, and freezing the VLM while tuning only the action expert yields the most steerable policy—so choosing the right checkpoint is all you need.
